source_snapshot.procedure: Install NVMe switch adapter, power on, enter BIOS and verify attached NVMe SSD/controller information.
source_snapshot.criteria: BIOS enters normally and controller information is correct.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; substantive NVMe BIOS scope requires operator, hardware/topology/spec and power/ESD recovery.

old_problem: Legacy SAS/SATA grouping obscured the literal NVMe switch-adapter BIOS test, while DeepSeek replaced primary physical/BIOS evidence with OS inventory.
disposition_reason: The Items suffix, Procedure and Criteria consistently establish NVMe switch-adapter installation and BIOS display; SAS/SATA is a legacy grouping label, not an alternate procedure. Hardware/topology/expected fields are project prerequisites. Because the source acceptance is physical install/power/BIOS observation, classification remains MANUAL ONLY.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row112 all18 XLSX cells and history2720.
Preserved NVMe adapter/SSD BIOS detection and complete controller information.
Rejected smartctl/lsblk as a substitute for installation and BIOS evidence; no physical, power or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Manual NVMe switch-adapter installation and BIOS controller/SSD information validation
test_case.purpose: Verify an approved NVMe switch adapter and all attached mapped SSDs are detected with correct controller/device information in BIOS after supported installation and power-on.
required_package: Approved adapter model/serial/firmware and motherboard slot/root-port compatibility
Adapter port-to-SSD serial/NGUID/slot topology and expected BIOS field matrix
Qualified operator, ESD controls and supported powered-off installation procedure
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator records baseline, powers down per platform procedure, installs the exact NVMe switch adapter and mapped SSDs with ESD controls, powers on and enters BIOS. Capture visual controller and every SSD model/serial/capacity/port/link field required by the approved matrix. Optional read-only OS PCI/NVMe inventory may corroborate only after BIOS acceptance.
test_case.expected_result: System POSTs and enters BIOS normally; the approved adapter/controller and every mapped NVMe SSD appear in the correct port/topology with all required fields matching specification and no platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical installation record and genuine BIOS/KVM evidence for the complete adapter/SSD matrix. Post-boot smartctl or lsblk alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Physical installation and power actions are operator-only.
Use approved slot/topology and ESD/power procedure; do not hot-insert unless explicitly supported.
Protect OS/data devices and capture baseline before hardware change.
Abort on no-POST, wrong adapter/SSD identity, PCIe/storage error or thermal/power issue; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Expected-field matrix comparison and POST/system logs
Optional OS corroboration plus removal/restore disposition
test_case.recovery: On no-POST or missing/wrong device, stop power attempts, preserve POST/KVM and physical topology evidence, have the operator power down and restore the recorded known-good hardware configuration, and require platform/storage owner review before reinstalling.
